notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
